newsitem.title: FRANCE: Bomb blast outside official's home in Corsica.
newsitem.headline: Bomb blast outside official's home in Corsica.

text.p: A bomb exploded outside the home of an Agriculture Ministry official on the restive French Mediterranean island of Corsica early on Friday causing damage but no casualties, police said.

No one immediately claimed responsability for the attack which resembled several similar actions in past years against officials seen by Corsican separatists as representatives of the central Paris government.
